name: Camps Hill Play Area
text: Council play area, refurbished and reopened in summer 2024 with new equipment chosen with local children.

name: Canterbury Way Playing Fields
text: Play area next to the car park with equipment for toddlers and juniors, refurbished in 2024 with trampolines, a group swing, activity trails and hang-out spaces for girls.

name: Chancellors Road Play Area
text: Council play area on Chancellors Road, refurbished and reopened in August 2024 with new equipment chosen with local children.

name: Chells Park Play Area
text: Small toddler play area next to the pavilion and near the main car park in Chells Park, which also has football and rugby pitches, basketball hoops and woodland walks in Lanterns Lane and Elm Green Woodlands.

name: Fairlands Valley Park Play Areas
text: An adventure trail and a main play area for toddlers to teens, next to the Aqua Playground water play.

name: Hampson Park
text: Play area next to the main car park, upgraded in 2009, with equipment for toddlers, juniors and teens; the park also has a BMX track.

name: King George V Playing Fields
text: Play area in front of the pavilion, improved in 2010, with equipment for toddlers, juniors and teens; car park at the main entrance (first 3 hours free, Mon-Sat).

name: Lapwing Rise Play Area
text: Council play area, refurbished and reopened in summer 2024 with new equipment chosen with local children.

name: Meadway Playing Fields
text: Play area next to the pavilion with a limited range of equipment for juniors; car park at the main entrance.

name: Parishes Mead Play Area
text: Council play area, refurbished and reopened in summer 2024 with new equipment chosen with local children.

name: Peartree Park
text: Play area at the north of the park with equipment for juniors, plus a small skate park and multi-use games area for teens.

name: Riccat Lane Play Area
text: Council play area on Riccat Lane, refurbished and reopened in August 2024 with new equipment chosen with local children.

name: Ridlins Park
text: Play area at the far west of the park, reached via Ridlins End or through the park, with a limited range of equipment for juniors.

name: Shearwater Close Play Area
text: Council play area, refurbished and reopened in summer 2024 with new equipment chosen with local children.

name: Shephalbury Park
text: Play area at the far west of the park, reached via Lodge Way, improved in 2010 with equipment for toddlers, juniors and teens.

name: St Nicholas Park
text: Play area next to the car park and play centre, upgraded in 2010, with three large mounds, equipment for toddlers, juniors and teens, a large BMX track and gym equipment.

name: Town Centre Gardens Play Area
text: Play area for children up to 16 in the Town Centre Gardens, reopened in March 2025 after a £250,000 refurbishment, with a bespoke pirate ship, a group swing, an activity trail, a trampoline and an inclusive roundabout. Local children chose the equipment.
